stories.title: Social media limits are coming for teens across Europe
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: The EU is considering major new regulations targeting teenagers' use of social media.
Potential restrictions include mandatory age limits, outright bans, and phased access to platforms.
Platforms may be required to demonstrate that their services are safe for young users before deployment.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a substantial developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance using Gemma 4 saw up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is its local-first architecture, allowing AI agents to run entirely on user hardware.
It integrates native support with Ollama, leveraging existing local LLM infrastructure.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, promising faster local AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development and adoption.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, emphasizing on-device processing.
The core value proposition is providing AI assistance while maintaining user data privacy by running locally.

stories.title: The 6 wildest claims in Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Apple has filed a major lawsuit against OpenAI.
The lawsuit alleges OpenAI stole confidential documents and spied on Apple hardware prototypes.
A key claim involves OpenAI's hardware head allegedly demanding unreleased product samples from job candidates.

stories.title: Now, defenders are embracing the prompt injection, too
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Defenders are now actively using prompt injection techniques against AI agents.
The specific technique mentioned is 'context bombing'.
This defensive strategy aims to trick hacking agents into prematurely terminating their operations.

stories.title: Simulating everything, sort of: The promise and limits of world models
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: The article discusses 'world models,' a concept aiming to simulate complex environments and systems.
It provides an expert analysis covering the current capabilities and inherent limitations of these simulation models.
The piece addresses the unsettled scientific and technical questions surrounding the full potential of world modeling in AI.

stories.title: Quantum error correction can constantly recalibrate a processor
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Quantum error correction is being advanced by using reinforcement learning.
The core mechanism involves using error information to dynamically adjust control algorithms.
This represents a significant step toward building stable and functional quantum processors.

stories.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Current large language models primarily rely on text corpora, overlooking rich visual information in documents and web pages.
The research addresses the limitation of text-only pretraining by proposing a method to incorporate visual cues.
The goal is to create scalable visual pretraining methods to enhance language intelligence by leveraging non-textual data like figures and layouts.

stories.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
stories.author: Ulf Schlichtmann
bullet_points: LLMs are being explored as a solution to bottlenecks in front-end chip design.
The technology aims to unify intelligent interfaces for HDL generation, testbench construction, and design space exploration.
The trend aligns with the rise of agentic AI in complex hardware development workflows.

stories.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
stories.author: Max Lübbering
bullet_points: Introduction of Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source MoE hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model.
Features a significant throughput advantage over dense models for long-context deployment by activating only 3B of 30B parameters per token.
Specifically designed for German and English, pretrained on 27 trillion tokens with an emphasis on German language data.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added to enhance Claude Code's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Even Nvidia’s head of automotive fights with Nvidia for compute
stories.author: Nilay Patel
bullet_points: Nvidia's automotive division is a key focus area, despite the company's current AI dominance.
The story suggests internal competition or strategic focus within Nvidia regarding compute resources.
It highlights the dual importance of Nvidia's GPU supply chain across both AI and automotive sectors.

stories.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Waze is integrating Google's Gemini AI assistant to enhance user experience.
The updates aim to allow users to personalize their driving trips more effectively.
Two of the four new features specifically leverage Gemini's capabilities.

stories.title: Apple and Samsung benefit as memory shortage pushes smartphone shipments to historic lows
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Smartphone shipments are hitting historic lows due to component shortages.
Despite market headwinds, major players like Apple and Samsung are maintaining sales.
The industry is facing dual pressures from supply chain issues and economic uncertainty.

stories.title: A "disaster waiting to happen"? Industry officials worry about Crew Dragon availability.
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Industry officials are expressing concern over the current availability of Crew Dragon vehicles.
There is a recognized and significant demand within the United States for more crew transportation capacity.
The shortage suggests potential operational bottlenecks or unmet needs in spaceflight logistics.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG data during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features, utilizing Persistent Homology for richer signal analysis.
Aims to improve dream content classification and enable topology-conditioned neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
stories.author: Miguel P. Eckstein
bullet_points: The paper addresses limitations in current Vision-Language Model (VLM) evaluations, which often rely on simple scenes (like MS-COCO).
It introduces the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, featuring 100 images designed to test complex human interactions.
The research focuses on analyzing the progression of VLM accuracy and specifically investigating the types of visual-cognitive errors made by these models.

stories.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
stories.author: Maanak Gupta
bullet_points: Introduces VEXAIoT, an autonomous multi-agent framework designed for IoT vulnerability exploitation.
Addresses the inherent security weaknesses of IoT systems (constrained hardware, outdated firmware).
Applies LLM agent technology to the specific, yet underexplored, domain of IoT security testing.

stories.title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
stories.author: Zhibao Mian
bullet_points: Introduces ConceptSMILE, a new model-agnostic framework for auditing the trustworthiness of concept-based Explainable AI (XAI).
Addresses the critical gap that concept-level explanations, while human-understandable, are not inherently reliable.
Extends perturbation-based auditing logic (similar to SMILE) from feature/region attribution to the evaluation of high-level concepts.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Proposes Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective RL framework for financial anomaly detection.
Addresses 'fraud collapse' in imbalanced datasets by balancing anomaly detection with customer friction.
Synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for encoding.

stories.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
stories.author: Hui-liang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces 4DR360, a new method for joint 3D detection and occupancy prediction using radar-camera fusion.
Addresses the limitation of sparse 4D radar returns by integrating it with camera data for comprehensive scene understanding.
Improves upon existing methods by enabling better interaction between detection and occupancy tasks, moving beyond simple dual-task decoding.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agora,' a framework designed to improve LLM agent reasoning by optimizing task allocation.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained matching of tasks to expert models.
Incorporates incentive-compatible mechanisms to account for performance variability and cost efficiency among functionally similar tools.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG signals related to dream states.
Moves beyond traditional methods (like PSD) by employing Persistent Homology for richer feature extraction from EEG data.
Aims to improve dream content classification and enable topology-conditioned neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Proposes Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework.
Addresses the 'fraud collapse' issue in financial anomaly detection caused by extreme class imbalance.
Synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for improved modeling.

stories.title: Entropy-Constrained Machine Learning with Residual Data Augmentation for Modeling Chemical Kinetics
stories.author: Opeoluwa Owoyele
bullet_points: Introduces a physics-constrained ML framework to accelerate Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) of turbulent reacting flows.
Uses a surrogate model to predict chemical reaction rates from a reduced thermochemical state, bypassing detailed source term evaluation.
Incorporates the second law of thermodynamics as a training constraint (non-negative entropy generation) to ensure physical consistency.

stories.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
stories.author: Haiqian Yang
bullet_points: Modern AI systems are limited by their fixed representational frames, including vocabulary and solution spaces.
The paper addresses the 'Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps' in current open-ended AI capabilities.
It argues for moving beyond fixed representations to enable stronger reasoning and long-horizon tasks.

stories.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
stories.author: Kentaro Inui
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit surprising failures in basic object counting despite overall strong performance.
The research suggests VLMs may internally encode the correct count even when their verbalized output is wrong.
Nonlinear probes applied to model activations can reliably detect these counting errors across multiple VLMs and datasets.

stories.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
stories.author: Richard Gao
bullet_points: Proposes CoCoT-EEG, a new Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG decoding.
Addresses limitations of current EEG modeling, specifically the suboptimality of raw EEG tokenization and masked reconstruction pretraining.
Focuses on leveraging self-supervised foundation models tailored for noisy, dimensionally constrained EEG data.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agora,' a new framework designed to improve LLM agent reasoning.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Utilizes an auction-based mechanism to allocate tasks, considering performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
stories.author: Md. Abdur Rahman
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical issue in deploying lightweight Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models on edge devices for non-Latin languages like Bengali.
The core problem identified is that English-centric byte-level tokenizers cause 'autoregressive collapse' when processing morphologically rich Bengali words.
A novel 'vocabulary transplantation pipeline' is proposed as a solution to improve ASR performance for these specific language challenges.

stories.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
stories.author: Mustafa Yavuz
bullet_points: Introduction of Freya-TTS, a compact, tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech (TTS) model.
The model utilizes a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive Conditional Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT).
It is specifically designed for efficient conversational synthesis, focusing on Turkish language support and leveraging AudioVAE2 for high-quality audio reconstruction.

stories.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
stories.author: Bruno Abrahao
bullet_points: The paper challenges the concept of 'incomplete neural collapse' in language models, proposing that within-class variance represents allocated information storage.
Analysis of 14 models shows that macro-category structure accounts for only 4-12% of representational variance.
The majority of representational variance (79-91%) is attributed to within-token context, a finding stable across large parameter counts.

stories.title: Apple's new SpeechAnalyzer API, benchmarked against Whisper and its predecessor
stories.author: get-inscribe
bullet_points: Apple has released a new SpeechAnalyzer API.
The new API is being benchmarked against OpenAI's Whisper model.
This indicates Apple is making significant strides in on-device speech recognition technology.

stories.title: Porting Gemma-4 (2B / 4B / 12B) to AWS Inferentia2
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article details the practical challenges of deploying Google's Gemma-4 models (2B/4B/12B) on AWS Inferentia2 hardware.
It highlights specific technical hurdles encountered, including issues with mixed attention heads and limitations in existing optimization frameworks (vLLM, optimum-neuron, NxD).
The report serves as a valuable field study for MLOps engineers looking to optimize LLM inference on specialized AWS silicon.
